M24.intro: The routines that keep PeopleOS accurate: what to look at every day, week, month, quarter and year, each pointing to the module and screen where it is done.
M24.why: Most payroll and compliance problems start as a small item left waiting: a missed punch, an unapproved request, a salary not executed.
M24.who: The organisation administrator, with the HR, payroll and time-office leads who own each step.
M24.where: Home and My work every day; the module screens named in each routine.
objectives: Clear Home, My work and the inbox every day
Close attendance and run payroll in the right order each month
Review access, policies and data every quarter and year
depends_on: M01 Sign in, Home and navigation

procedures.title: Your daily routine
steps: Read Home
Act on every Governance item and the decisions waiting for you (M01).
Clear My work
Inbox: approve, reject or send back what waits for you; chase anything Overdue (M02).
Check new joiners
People › Lifecycle › Upcoming joiners: position, manager and documents ready for day one (M08).
Work attendance exceptions
Time & leave › Exception centre and Attendance records › Incomplete (M10).
Answer employees
Services › HR queue: take, reply and resolve within the SLA (M20).
Read notifications
The bell: failures, reminders and decisions addressed to you (M01).
procedures.result: Nothing waits on you at the end of the day, and problems are found while they are small.

procedures.title: Your weekly routine
procedures.before: The daily routine is up to date.
steps: Leave and regularisations
Leave requests and Regularisations: nothing old still pending (M10, M11).
Employee data changes
Insights › Audit › Change history: review the week's changes to people, roles and pay (M23).
Stuck approvals
Task inbox › All open tasks and Workflows › Runs: steps waiting for people who left or are away (M02, M06).
Assets and service
Asset requests and the HR queue's breached SLAs (M18, M20).
Sign-in failures
Change history filtered on failed and blocked logins (M26).
procedures.result: Requests keep moving and unusual changes are noticed within a week.

procedures.title: Your monthly routine
procedures.before: The month has ended; its requests are decided.
steps: Close attendance
Run attendance: absences genuine, overtime and penalties decided, every day processed (M10).
Check paid days
Paid days for a few employees; unpaid leave approved (M10, M11).
Run payroll
Run payroll: inputs, checks, calculate, review, approve by a second person, close, publish (M13).
Pay and reconcile
Bank file and journal voucher, then Mark as paid once the bank has paid (M13).
Expenses
Expense desk and Pay expenses: claims paid or scheduled with payroll (M15).
Statutory
After closing: returns and challans per establishment, where the rules are verified (M14).
Report
Run your monthly reports from the Report library (M22).
procedures.result: A closed, published and paid month, with its statutory work started.

procedures.title: Your quarterly routine
procedures.before: A quiet week after a payroll close.
steps: Access review
User access review report, Tenant Super Admin holders, scopes and dormant accounts (M05).
Policy review
Policies: versions in force and who each reaches; remove stray drafts (M06).
Employee master audit
Employee master report: missing PAN, UAN, bank, manager or location (M07, M22).
Audit chain
Change history › verify the chain and keep the result as evidence (M23).
Performance check-in
Goal sheets and check-ins on track for the cycle (M16).
procedures.result: Access, policies and data are still right, with evidence kept.

procedures.title: Your annual routine
procedures.before: Agree the year's calendar with HR and payroll.
steps: Holidays
Next year's holiday calendars published per location (M10).
Leave year end
Carry forward leaves: preview, then post; check new opening balances (M11).
Tax year
Declarations window, proofs, Form 130 certificates and Form 138 statements (M14).
Performance cycle
Launch, run and close the review cycle; publish ratings (M16).
Pay review
Pay review cycle, ranges and budgets; revisions through compensation changes (M12).
Structure review
Companies, units, designations and positions still match the organisation (M03, M19).
procedures.result: The new year starts with correct balances, calendars, policies and structure.

warnings.title: Do the month in order
warnings.headline: Attendance first, then payroll, then statutory work.
warnings.body: Payroll reads the month's processed attendance and approved leave. Returns and challans are generated only from a closed payroll month.
points: Changing attendance after payroll is calculated means recalculating the run.
A closed month can be reopened only until it is marked paid or a return is filed.
warnings.todo: Follow the monthly routine top to bottom and do not skip a step.

checklist: Daily: Home and My work cleared
Governance items and decisions acted on.
Incomplete days and requests followed up.
People, role and pay changes reviewed.
The person who ran payroll did not approve it.
Bank file sent; month marked paid.
Report run, scopes checked, leavers suspended.
summary: Every day: Home, My work, joiners, exceptions and the HR queue.
Every week: requests, Change history and stuck approvals.
Every month: attendance, then payroll with a second approver, then payment and statutory work.
Every quarter: access review, policy review, data audit and the audit chain.
Every year: carry forward, holidays, tax year, performance cycle and structure review.

M25.intro: What to do when something does not work as expected: the symptom you see, why it happens and the safe fix, collected from every module of this course.
M25.why: Most problems have a simple cause inside your organisation's set-up; knowing where to look saves time and keeps data safe.
M25.who: The organisation administrator, first line for your own users.
M25.where: The screen where the problem appears, then the module named in the last column.
objectives: Recognise the common messages and what causes them
Fix the cause safely, without editing closed records
Know when to contact PeopleOS support and what to send

procedures.title: Before you contact PeopleOS support
procedures.before: You have tried the fix in this module and in the module named.
steps: Note the exact message
Copy the text on screen, or take a screenshot without personal data.
Note where and when
The page (menu path), the date and time, and who was signed in.
Name the record
Employee code, request number or payroll month, never bank or ID numbers.
Check Change history
Insights › Audit › Change history for what changed just before (M23).
Contact support
Send the above through your organisation's agreed support channel.
procedures.result: Support can reproduce the problem quickly without seeing sensitive data.

warnings.title: What only PeopleOS can do
warnings.headline: Some settings and records are maintained by PeopleOS, not by your organisation.
points: Verifying statutory rule versions and resolving regulatory changes.
Switching on features that are turned off for your organisation.
Session and sign-in settings that are not on your Security policy.
Correcting records your screens refuse to change after payroll is closed.
warnings.todo: Ask PeopleOS support, with the details listed on the previous slide.

25.1: 'Too many login attempts. Please try again in N seconds.'
Five attempts in a minute from this network address.
Wait the seconds shown, then try once, or reset the password.
'This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.'
The link is older than 60 minutes, was used, or a newer one was requested.
Request a new link and use only the newest e-mail.
The page 'Choose a new password' after signing in
Your password is older than the organisation's Expire after days.
Enter Current password, a new one twice and click Change password.
The page 'Set up two-factor authentication'
Your organisation requires two-factor sign-in and you have no authenticator.
Set up the authenticator app, keep the recovery codes, then Continue.
User cannot sign in, status Suspended
Suspended by hand, by completing their exit, or by the Disable login rule for their employee status.
If they should work, set Status to Active with a reason; check Security policy › Disable login.
User cannot see a module or menu
None of their active roles holds the permission the page needs, the role is inactive, or the grant is limited to another company.
Check Roles by person; add a role or the missing key; check the Companies column in the role's Members tab.
User sees nobody in one module
They belong to a data access group that is not valid, or that reaches nobody.
Open Data access groups; fix the group whose Check column shows a warning, or switch it off.
User cannot sign in from the office or home
Their address is not in the Security policy IP allowlist.
Add the address or range under Access › IP allowlist, or ask them to use an allowed network.
25.2: Red message "This person already exists" after the Person step
Another person has the same personal e-mail, personal phone or work e-mail.
Select that person in Existing person, or correct the details. Someone who worked here before returns with Rehire / reactivate.
"Not hired" with a reason
One part (seat, starting state, bank, returning check…) was refused; the hire is one transaction.
Nothing was saved. Fix the step named in the message and create again.
The manager I want is not in the list
Only employed people in your access scope are offered: not pre-joiners, exited, alumni or not joined, and never the person themselves.
Mark the manager as joined first, or ask for a wider access scope.
Task shows Unassigned
Its owner could not be found when the plan started.
Complete or skip it as HR, or use role owners in the template.
"Assets still in custody: … Take them back, or record a recoverable amount."
Assets are still assigned to the leaver.
Return them in Assets, or enter Amount to recover in F&F.
Assets can only be assigned to current employees.
The chosen person has left or is not employed
Choose a current employee
25.3: A day shows Incomplete
Only an IN or only an OUT punch fell in the shift's punch window
Regularise with the missing time, or add a Manual punch with a note
Working days show Absent with 'No shift assigned'
No work schedule, schedule rule or rostered day covers the employee
Add an Applies to rule or roster the days, then Reprocess
Balance looks wrong
Pending requests reserve days, or an entry is missing
Read Transactions for the employee, type and period; adjust with a note
'Insufficient … balance' at approval
Another approval or adjustment used the days meanwhile
Check Balances; adjust or ask for another type
Opening balance row skipped
An opening balance for that year is already on file
Use Kind adjustment for the difference
25.4: Salary structure missing: N to clear
People in the month have no approved salary in force.
Assign salary structures (M12), then count again.
'Structure X has no approved version in force on <date>.'
The version is still a draft, waiting for approval, or starts after the effective date.
Get the version approved, or use an effective date on or after its start.
Revision approved but payslip shows the old salary
The change is Approved, not executed; or the run was calculated before execution.
Execute (schedule) it, then recalculate the payroll run.
Not allowed: Finish the steps before the run in Run payroll first …
Attendance is not done (e.g. the month has not ended) or a pre-payroll check is blocked or not ticked.
Open Run payroll, finish Attendance and Pre-payroll checks, then calculate.
N employee(s) have blocking exceptions. Fix the inputs and recalculate.
Validate found employees with Status Exception.
Filter Employees by Exception, open Breakdown, fix the cause, recalculate.
Compensation changed for N employee(s) since the run was calculated …
A salary was approved or changed after calculation.
Recalculate, validate and approve again.
Run totals do not reconcile with its entries …
Totals no longer match the entries.
Recalculate the run.
An employee cannot see their payslip
Payslips are not published yet.
Run payroll › Publish payslips › Publish payslips.
No primary bank account although one was added
The run was calculated before the account was added.
Recalculate the run.
Payroll exception 'formula_error' naming a component
A formula failed, e.g. an unknown name or a lookup() with no entry and no final value.
Fix the formula in the builder (or component) and recalculate; the line was paid as 0.
25.5: An approver says the request is not in their inbox
They lack the approval right, the employee is outside their access scope, or a workflow now decides it.
Check their roles and scope (M05); open Workflow and policy on the request to see who it waits with.
The decision fails with "This item is no longer waiting for your decision"
Someone else decided it, it was withdrawn, or your rights changed.
Refresh the inbox; check the request's trail with Workflow and policy.
Approval waits for a manager who has left
The manager's account is inactive and no manager reliever is set.
Reassign the task; set the reliever for the line manager in Admin › Setup › Automation.
Manager is not in the route
The employee has no current reporting manager, or the manager has no sign-in.
Set the reporting manager on the employee (M07) and give the manager a sign-in (M05).
Submitted for approval when you save
Configuration approval is on and the record is at or above the minimum risk.
An approver opens Change Centre › Pending approval and approves it.
A manager sees requests from the whole organisation
The manager's user has no access scope, so it reaches every employee.
Edit the user and add an access scope (for example their team) in Admin › Setup › Users.

summary: Read the exact message: most name their cause.
Access problems are usually roles, scopes or a suspended account.
Payroll problems are usually missing salaries, unprocessed attendance or late changes: recalculate after fixing.
Never edit a closed month: correct it in the next month or reopen it while that is allowed.
Contact PeopleOS support for provider-maintained rules and switched-off features.
